Now write the plural forms of the following nouns:
thief __________
leaf __________
wolf __________
shelf __________
life __________

(ii) Plurals are often formed by making an internal change of vowels:
foot feet
tooth teeth
man men

Now fill in the following blanks with plurals:
goose __________
mouse __________
woman __________
louse __________

(iii) Look at the plurals of some compound words:
| Singular | Plural |
| :--- | :--- |
| boy-friend | boy-friends |
| take-off | take-offs |
| step-son | step-sons |
| passer-by | passers-by |
| looker-on | lookers-on |
| runner-up | runners-up |
| father-in-law | fathers-in-law |
| man-of-war | men-of-war |

(iv) Nouns ending in is have es in the plural:
| Singular | Plural |
| :--- | :--- |
| thesis | theses |
| crisis | crises |
| basis | bases |
| diagnosis | diagnoses |
| synopsis | synopses |
